description: This file is a script that analyzes TypeScript source code to identify deprecated usage of 'registerHttpHandler'. It imports TypeScript compiler APIs and utility functions to parse source files, collect specific call expressions, and produce warnings or reports about deprecated plugin API calls related to HTTP handler registration.

methods.name: isDeprecatedRegisterHttpHandlerCall
methods.description: Checks if a given expression is a property access expression with the property name 'registerHttpHandler', indicating a deprecated API usage.

methods.name: findDeprecatedRegisterHttpHandlerLines
methods.description: Parses a source file's content to locate lines where the deprecated 'registerHttpHandler' API is called.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function that runs the script to scan for deprecated registerHttpHandler calls and outputs a warning message with guidance.
